title: Extend FA3 Model Manager with canonical model record, multi-provider projections, storage-plane separation, HRB admission and fail-closed promotion
decisions: FA3 Model Manager remains a provider-neutral cross-cutting projection and is not a new architectural authority.
FA3-MODEL-REGISTRY-001 defines the canonical provider-neutral model record; registry authority remains FA3-REGISTRY-001.
StabilityMatrix remains the primary current-host media model-store/provider projection for natively supported model classes.
Hugging Face is admitted as the primary upstream source/revision/content-addressed cache projection when used.
LM Studio is a strong optional interactive LLM desktop/model-library/runtime projection provider; production promotion requires a local immutable runtime/package pin and E2E evidence.
Ollama is a strong optional LLM packaging/native-store/serving provider; its native store is not canonical model identity authority.
Model family, immutable revision, variant, artifact, runtime projection and loaded instance are distinct identities.
Source cache, canonical artifact store and runtime projection stores are distinct storage planes.
Model Manager declares resource requirements; Host Resource Broker alone authorizes accelerator admission/placement/lease.
Unknown license, trust, lineage or runtime compatibility blocks promotion.
Floating latest/main cannot constitute production admission evidence.
